title: Checkboxes drawn as physical switches
blurb: Six switches from ui-feed.dev rebuilt as custom elements around one native checkbox: mercury in a tilting vial, a Newton's cradle, rockers, a frost alarm with a liquid crystal display, soft clay and a pencil answer sheet. The checkbox is never painted. The canvas draws a model from its state and puts its hit region over the drawing.
question: Can a checkbox stay the thing that is tapped, focused, toggled with Space and submitted while the canvas that holds it draws a physical model instead of the checkbox?
result: Yes in the test browser. A draw with no alpha places the hit region, the slotted label still toggles it, and the form value comes from ElementInternals. The model can lag the checkbox by up to half a second.
